signals.summary: Mistral closed a €3B Series D at a post-money valuation above €21B (about $24B). Samsung led the round, with Scaleup Europe Fund (EQT) and PSG co-leading. Advent, BlackRock-managed funds and Luxembourg joined as new investors. It is Europe's largest private tech raise, and the proceeds go to research, compute and international commercialisation.

Mistral launched a public preview of Mistral Large 4 ('le Chonk'), a roughly 1T-parameter open-weight model aimed at cyber, coding, manufacturing, finance and multimodal work. It was trained on Mistral's own European datacenters. Weights are due to be released on Oct 27.

CERN and Mistral signed a statement of intent for a long-term strategic partnership to build foundation models for scientific discovery, starting with a Large Physics Model for collider physics. No timeline or budget was disclosed.
Samsung Electronics announced a strategic partnership with Mistral to enhance its semiconductor engineering and manufacturing. The snippet was dated only '5 weeks ago', so the date is approximate.

Microsoft and Mistral announced an expanded strategic partnership, backed by a new multibillion-dollar Microsoft commitment to expand Mistral's Europe-based GPU infrastructure. The snippet was dated only '2 months ago'.

Mistral opened a Munich hub for Physics AI and Industrial AI, with applied engineers serving enterprise partners. It is working with BMW on crash simulation and Siemens Energy on industrial AI, and has a research partnership with TU Munich. The hub builds on the Emmi AI acquisition in May 2026.
Mistral acquired design studio New Material, which will form a new 'Solutions Design' group that works with customers on AI deployments. No price was disclosed.

LinkedIn's 2026 French Top Startups list ranks Mistral first, based partly on hiring growth and talent attraction. Separately, research staff made up only 29% of technical staff in H1 2026, which points to a shift toward applied and enterprise engineering.

answer.notes: The funding, Large 4 and CERN signals are well sourced and dated. Several signals have no exact date: the Samsung and Microsoft partnerships, the Munich hub, the New Material acquisition and the hiring items. The Emmi AI acquisition (May 2026) falls outside the 90-day window and is mentioned only as context. Revenue is last reported at about $400M ARR with a $1B target, which comes from secondary sources. I found no leadership changes or layoffs, but I did not search for them directly. A shattered.io article also mentions a Shieldstral safety model, a robotics model and a formal-verification tool, but I did not verify these and left them out. Good conversation hooks are the Large 4 weights release on Oct 27, the compute and datacenter build-out, and the push into industrial, physics and sovereign AI in Europe.
